+    ) -> tuple[dict[str, str], int]:
+        """Merge incoming identifiers and count identifiers already in common.
+
+        An identifier type can only have one value for an author. Empty incoming

+        existing_ids = self.get("remote_ids", {}) or {}
+        merged_ids = dict(existing_ids)

+                matching_ids += 1
+            elif incoming_value or identifier_type not in merged_ids:
